0022600187.text: Entering this 8th game of the season, the Magic (2-5, 11th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast) are on a two-game losing streak and have won both road games but none of their four home games, while the Suns (1-3, 12th in the West) are also on a two-game skid. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (rest), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 115-111 Magic win in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
